name: No Death No Life
source:
After Death grants you an immortality necklace, your fear of death dissipates, but what will you do with your endless life?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4912560/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当死神赐予你一条不朽项链后，你对死亡的恐惧烟消云散；可面对永无止境的生命，你又将何去何从？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4912560/]Steam[/url]]
